hooks.name: Contrôle des limites Minitel
hooks.description: Contrôle les pages de tous les services et de l’accueil après une sauvegarde sous src/services/, puis échoue avec le détail de chaque dépassement.

action.command: npx --no-install tsx -e 'import { readdir } from "node:fs/promises"; import { resolve } from "node:path"; import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url"; import { formatText, pageWeight } from "./src/core/formatter"; import { generateHomepage } from "./src/services/home"; void (async () => { const directory = resolve("src/services"); const files = (await readdir(directory)).filter((file) => file.endsWith(".ts") && !file.endsWith(".test.ts")); const services = []; for (const file of files) { const exports = await import(pathToFileURL(resolve(directory, file)).href); for (const candidate of Object.values(exports)) { if (candidate && typeof candidate === "object" && typeof candidate.code === "string" && typeof candidate.title === "string" && typeof candidate.render === "function") services.push(candidate); } } const checks = []; for (const service of services) checks.push([service.code, formatText(await service.render())]); checks.push(["ACCUEIL", generateHomepage(services)]); const violations = []; for (const [label, pages] of checks) { for (const page of pages) { const bytes = pageWeight(page); if (bytes >= 2048) violations.push(`${label}, page ${page.pageNumber}: ${bytes} octets (limite stricte: 2048)`); page.content.forEach((line, index) => { const columns = Array.from(line).length; if (columns > 40) violations.push(`${label}, page ${page.pageNumber}, ligne ${index + 1}: ${columns} colonnes (limite: 40)`); }); } } if (violations.length > 0) { console.error("Dépassement des limites Minitel :\n" + violations.join("\n")); process.exitCode = 1; } else { console.log("Pages Minitel conformes : moins de 2 Ko et 40 colonnes maximum."); } })().catch((error) => { console.error("Vérification des pages impossible :", error); process.exitCode = 1; });'
